title: SB1129 (2026 Regular Session): Modifies provisions relating to concealed carry permits

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.121 (RSMo): Carrying and display of a concealed carry permit or endorsement as required under this subsection may be accomplished by the carrying and display of a digital copy of such concealed carry permit or endorsement, which includes but is not limited to a personal photograph of the permit or endorsement stored digitally on an electronic device.
Section 571.230 (RSMo): Carrying and display of a permit as required under this subsection may be accomplished by the carrying and display of a digital copy of such permit, which includes but is not limited to a personal photograph of the permit stored digitally on an electronic device.
